title: Visitor bays marked and signposted, on common property and connected to building entries
text: Visitor car parking spaces to be: i. marked and clearly signposted as dedicated for visitor use only; ii. located on common property; and iii. connected to building entries via a continuous path of travel.

replaces.note: 'close to or visible from the entry' and 'outside any security barrier' not carried

notes: from: ch3 C2.3.4. diverges: fact parking.visitor_bays_signed_common_property (Chapter 4 Part 1 vocabulary) replaces parking.visitor_spaces_marked_and_accessible; read as covering all of (i) to (iii) (FACTS-PROPOSED-part2.md). Applies wherever visitor bays are provided. Region all.
